description: An open, angular ribbon of recording tape curls around the support character, ending in large rewind arrowheads. Small tape splices and separated musical-free timing marks keep the effect office-machine themed and visibly different from a ring aura.
toggle_contract: Set this subtree visible/invisible in the target engine. Geometry has no autonomous playback; caller controls visibility and any motion.

fx_tape_rewind.note: Rigid articulation, artistic guide; not a collision guarantee.

gameplay_status: Art/FX concept only. No engine primitive, gameplay logic, collision, timing or ability integration implemented.
